**What are you trying to do?**
Describe the problem or workflow gap, not just the feature.

**Is this in scope?**
This fork is deliberately slim (PSIRT, vulnerability tracking, Art. 14
reporting, users/roles, local+Entra-ID+LDAP auth — see `README.md`).
TARA/STRIDE, SBOM ingestion, and conformity assessment are intentionally out
of scope. If your request reintroduces that surface area, say why this
fork's scope should grow rather than assuming it will.

**Proposed approach (optional)**
If you have a rough idea of how this would work, sketch it here.
